Return one decision for every candidate index. add stages a new exact candidate; support requires exact observed normalized target content and its current version; correct is only for a user correction_or_rejection candidate and its current target version; conflict records an unresolved contradiction; unresolved records a missing or uncertain target. Use only observed target IDs and versions. Never generate replacement content. Non-user attributed history cannot support or correct a direct user fact. All targets listed here already exist in the store. Candidate indices and source offsets are not fact versions. A new independent fact requires add even when there are no targets or the targets describe unrelated facts. Missing a matching target is not a reason to leave a new independent fact unresolved. A direct user candidate that exactly matches one existing target after normalization requires support with that target's observed version, not another add. If multiple target identities match, use unresolved rather than choosing one. A correction whose intended target is missing or ambiguous also requires unresolved; do not relabel uncertain target identity as conflict.
